def render_preview(config, has_protein: bool, protein_only: bool = False) -> None:
    """Draw the preview page: all settings at a glance and the Build button.

    When proteins and membrane belong to different Martini generations, a warning is
    shown and building needs an explicit confirmation.

    Args:
        config: The settings to show.
        has_protein: Show the protein part.
        protein_only: Proteins in water: no composition is shown.
    """
    def md(label, val):
        # values are user input (output name, file names) -> escape before injecting HTML
        """One label with its value below it (text is made safe for the page)."""
        return (
            f'<p style="font-size:17px; color:gray; margin:0">{html.escape(str(label))}</p>'
            f'<p style="font-size:20px; font-weight:600; margin:0 0 16px 0">'
            f'{html.escape(str(val)) if val else " "}</p>'
        )

    def row(label1, val1, label2="", val2=""):
        """Two label/value pairs side by side."""
        c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
        c1.markdown(md(label1, val1), unsafe_allow_html=True)
        c2.markdown(md(label2, val2), unsafe_allow_html=True)

    def row4(l1, v1, l2, v2, l3, v3, l4, v4):
        """Four label/value pairs side by side."""
        c1, c2, c3, c4 = st.columns(4)
        for c, l, v in [(c1, l1, v1), (c2, l2, v2), (c3, l3, v3), (c4, l4, v4)]:
            c.markdown(md(l, v), unsafe_allow_html=True)

    def content():
        """The summary sections and the Back / Build buttons."""
        st.subheader("Please check your settings before building.")

        with st.expander("⚙️ General", expanded=True):
            row("Force field", config.selected_ff, "Number of systems", str(config.n_systems))
            if config.output_name:
                row("Output name", config.output_name)

        with st.expander("📦 Box", expanded=True):
            row4("Type", config.box_type, "X (nm)", str(config.box_x), "Y (nm)", str(config.box_y), "Z (nm)", str(config.box_z))

        with st.expander("💧 Solvation", expanded=True):
            st.code(config.solvation or "—")

        if not protein_only:
            with st.expander("🧪 Membrane Composition", expanded=True):
                row("Absolute values", str(config.abs_lip_vals), "Template active", str(config.template_active))
                headers = ["Lipid", "NU" if config.abs_lip_vals else "RU", "NL" if config.abs_lip_vals else "RL", "AU", "AL"]
                if config.template_active and isinstance(config.entries, dict):
                    for template_name, entries in config.entries.items():
                        st.markdown(f"**{template_name}**")
                        st.dataframe(pd.DataFrame(entries, columns=headers), use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
                elif config.entries:
                    st.dataframe(pd.DataFrame(config.entries, columns=headers), use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)

        if has_protein:
            with st.expander("🧬 Protein Insertion", expanded=True):
                distance_mode = getattr(config, "use_protein_distance", False) and len(config.protein_files) == 2
                if distance_mode:
                    row("Distance between proteins (nm)", str(config.protein_distance))
                    st.divider()

                insertion_params = getattr(config, "insertion_params", {}) or {}
                for pdb_name, paths in config.protein_files.items():
                    p = config.protein_params.get("R0001", {}).get(pdb_name, {})
                    ip = insertion_params.get(pdb_name, {})

                    st.markdown(f"#### {pdb_name}")
                    row("PDB file", pdb_name, "ITP file", os.path.basename(paths["itp_path"]))

                    if ip.get("more_copies") and ip.get("copy_number", 1) > 1:
                        row(
                            "Copies per system",
                            str(ip["copy_number"]),
                            "Randomize rotation (all copies)",
                            str(ip.get("randomize_rot_all_copies", False)),
                        )

                    if distance_mode:
                        pass
                    elif ip.get("randomize_pos"):
                        row(
                            "Position",
                            "Randomized",
                            "Re-randomize per system" if config.n_systems > 1 else "",
                            str(ip.get("randomize_pos_every", False)) if config.n_systems > 1 else "",
                        )
                    else:
                        row("Position X, Y (nm)", f"{p.get('cx', 0.0)}, {p.get('cy', 0.0)}")

                    if ip.get("z_method") == "Height above Membrane":
                        row(
                            "Z placement",
                            "Height above Membrane",
                            "Distance to membrane (nm)",
                            str(ip.get("distance_to_mem", 2.0)),
                        )
                    else:
                        row("Z placement", "Absolute", "Z (nm)", str(p.get("cz", 0.0)))

                    if ip.get("randomize_rot"):
                        row(
                            "Rotation",
                            "Randomized",
                            "Re-randomize per system" if config.n_systems > 1 else "",
                            str(ip.get("randomize_rot_every", False)) if config.n_systems > 1 else "",
                        )
                    else:
                        row("Rotation X, Y, Z (°)", f"{p.get('rx', 0.0)}, {p.get('ry', 0.0)}, {p.get('rz', 0.0)}")

                    st.divider()

        # Martini 2 / 3 mismatch: warn, and require an explicit confirmation before building
        blocked = False
        ff_msg = ff_mismatch_message(config.protein_files if has_protein else {}, config.selected_ff)
        if ff_msg:
            if st.session_state.get("_ff_mismatch_msg") != ff_msg:
                st.session_state["_ff_mismatch_msg"] = ff_msg
                st.session_state["ff_mismatch_ack"] = False
            st.warning(ff_msg)
            ack = st.checkbox("I understand the risk and want to build anyway", key="ff_mismatch_ack")
            blocked = not ack
        else:
            st.session_state.pop("_ff_mismatch_msg", None)

        with st.container(key="nav_preview"):
            st.divider()
            left, _, right = st.columns([1, 6, 1])
            if left.button("← Back", use_container_width=True):
                st.session_state["_preview_action"] = "back"
                st.rerun()
            if right.button("🔨 Build", use_container_width=True, type="primary", disabled=blocked):
                st.session_state["_preview_action"] = "build"
                st.rerun()

    GlobalGui.render_page(title="Preview", content_fn=content, layout="wide")

def _parse_solvation(solvation: str) -> dict:
    """Read ions, salt and antifreeze water back from a solvation text.

    Args:
        solvation: Solvation in COBY's notation.

    Returns:
        `pos_ion`, `neg_ion`, `salt_molarity` and `replace_w_percentage`, with defaults
        for anything not found.
    """
    result = {
        "pos_ion": "NA",
        "neg_ion": "CL",
        "salt_molarity": 0.15,
        "replace_w_percentage": 0.0,
    }
    if not solvation:
        return result

    pos = re.search(r"pos:(\w+)", solvation)
    neg = re.search(r"neg:(\w+)", solvation)
    salt = re.search(r"salt_molarity:([\d.]+)", solvation)
    wf = re.search(r"solv:WF([\d.]+)", solvation)

    if pos:
        result["pos_ion"] = pos.group(1)
    if neg:
        result["neg_ion"] = neg.group(1)
    if salt:
        result["salt_molarity"] = float(salt.group(1))
    if wf:
        result["replace_w_percentage"] = float(wf.group(1))
    return result

docs.text:
The schematic system view of the protein insertion page.

It draws the box, the membrane and every protein as a simple picture (SVG), seen from the side (x–z or y–z) or from the top (x–y). Each protein is drawn as the outline of its own beads, placed and rotated exactly the way COBY will place it:

  1. the protein is centred on the middle of its beads (centre of geometry),
  2. it is rotated by the angles you entered (first about x, then y, then z, in the protein's own frame – COBY's convention),
  3. it is moved to the position you entered, measured from the centre of the box.

The membrane is drawn with a typical Martini thickness. "Height above Membrane" is therefore only approximate in the picture; the build measures the real membrane surface.

def box_extent(box_type: str, bx: float, by: float, bz: float) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    """The size of the box along x, y and z, in nm.

    Hexagonal boxes are not rectangular; the picture uses the rectangle around them.

    Args:
        box_type: `"rectangular"`, `"hexagonal"` or `"skewed_hexagonal"`.
        bx: Box length x, in nm.
        by: Box length y, in nm (rectangular boxes only).
        bz: Box height z, in nm (not used by skewed hexagonal boxes).

    Returns:
        `(x, y, z)` in nm.
    """
    if box_type == "hexagonal":
        return bx, bx * math.sqrt(3) / 2, bz
    if box_type == "skewed_hexagonal":
        return bx, bx * math.sqrt(3) / 2, bx * math.sqrt(2 / 3)
    return bx, by, bz

def place(coords_A: np.ndarray, cx: float, cy: float, cz: float, rx: float, ry: float, rz: float) -> np.ndarray:
    """Bead positions of a protein after COBY places it.

    Args:
        coords_A: Bead positions as read from the file, in Å.
        cx: Position along x, in nm from the box centre.
        cy: Position along y, in nm from the box centre.
        cz: Position along z, in nm from the box centre.
        rx: Rotation about x, in degrees.
        ry: Rotation about y, in degrees.
        rz: Rotation about z, in degrees.

    Returns:
        Bead positions in nm, measured from the box centre.
    """
    c = (coords_A - coords_A.mean(0)) @ coby_rotation(rx, ry, rz).T / 10.0
    return c + np.array([cx, cy, cz])

def height_above_membrane_cz(coords_A, rx, ry, rz, distance_to_mem: float) -> float:
    """The z position that puts the lowest bead a given distance above the membrane.

    Uses the typical membrane thickness of the picture (`MEMBRANE_HALF`).

    Args:
        coords_A: Bead positions as read from the file, in Å.
        rx: Rotation about x, in degrees.
        ry: Rotation about y, in degrees.
        rz: Rotation about z, in degrees.
        distance_to_mem: Gap between membrane surface and protein, in nm.

    Returns:
        The z position of the protein centre, in nm from the box centre.
    """
    c = (coords_A - coords_A.mean(0)) @ coby_rotation(rx, ry, rz).T / 10.0
    return MEMBRANE_HALF + distance_to_mem - c[:, 2].min()

def half_extent_x(coords_A, rx, ry, rz) -> float:
    """Half of the width of the rotated protein along x, in nm.

    Used when two proteins are placed by the gap between them.

    Args:
        coords_A: Bead positions as read from the file, in Å.
        rx: Rotation about x, in degrees.
        ry: Rotation about y, in degrees.
        rz: Rotation about z, in degrees.

    Returns:
        Half the x width, in nm.
    """
    c = (coords_A - coords_A.mean(0)) @ coby_rotation(rx, ry, rz).T / 10.0
    return (c[:, 0].max() - c[:, 0].min()) / 2.0

def make_grid(boxx: float, boxy: float, n_copies: int) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
    """The grid on which copies "moving together" are placed.

    The box is divided into n × n equal cells (n = smallest whole number with
    n² ≥ number of copies); the copies go into the centres of randomly chosen cells.

    Args:
        boxx: Box length x, in nm.
        boxy: Box length y, in nm.
        n_copies: Number of copies.

    Returns:
        The cell centres `(x, y)` in nm from the box centre.
    """
    n = math.ceil(math.sqrt(n_copies))
    dx, dy = boxx / n, boxy / n
    return [((i + 0.5) * dx - boxx / 2, (j + 0.5) * dy - boxy / 2) for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]

def _hull2d(pts: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """The outline (convex hull) of a set of points in the plane, in drawing order.

    Args:
        pts: Points `(h, v)`.

    Returns:
        The corner points of the outline.
    """
    pts = np.unique(np.round(np.asarray(pts, float), 3), axis=0)
    if len(pts) <= 2:
        return pts

    def cross(o, a, b):
        """Which side of the line o→a the point b lies on (positive: left)."""
        return (a[0] - o[0]) * (b[1] - o[1]) - (a[1] - o[1]) * (b[0] - o[0])

    lower, upper = [], []
    for q in map(tuple, pts):
        while len(lower) >= 2 and cross(lower[-2], lower[-1], q) <= 0:
            lower.pop()
        lower.append(q)
    for q in map(tuple, pts[::-1]):
        while len(upper) >= 2 and cross(upper[-2], upper[-1], q) <= 0:
            upper.pop()
        upper.append(q)
    return np.array(lower[:-1] + upper[:-1])

def system_view_svg(extent: tuple[float, float, float], proteins: list[dict], membrane: bool, view: str = "x–z") -> str:
    """The picture of the system, seen along one axis, as SVG text.

    Args:
        extent: Box size `(x, y, z)` in nm.
        proteins: One entry per protein: `name`, `copies` (bead positions of every copy,
            in nm from the box centre) and `dashed` (`True` when the position or rotation
            is random, so the picture shows only one possibility).
        membrane: Draw the membrane in the middle of the box.
        view: `"x–z"`, `"y–z"` or `"x–y"`.

    Returns:
        SVG text that can be put straight into the page.
    """
    ha, va = VIEWS.get(view, (0, 2))
    bh, bv = extent[ha], extent[va]
    zview = va == 2
    W, H, pad = 420, 320, 14
    sc = min((W - 2 * pad) / bh, (H - 2 * pad) / bv)
    oh, ov = (W - bh * sc) / 2, (H - bv * sc) / 2
    X = lambda h: oh + (h + bh / 2) * sc  # noqa: E731
    Z = lambda v: ov + (bv / 2 - v) * sc  # noqa: E731
    lip = "#5a7a1a"
    g = [f'<rect x="{oh}" y="{ov}" width="{bh * sc}" height="{bv * sc}" fill="#2f6fb4" fill-opacity=".12" stroke="#9aa6b0"/>']
    if membrane:
        if zview:
            g.append(f'<rect x="{oh}" y="{Z(MEMBRANE_HALF)}" width="{bh * sc}" height="{2 * MEMBRANE_HALF * sc}" fill="{lip}" fill-opacity=".35"/>')
            for pz in (PHOSPHATE, -PHOSPHATE):
                g.append(f'<line x1="{oh}" x2="{oh + bh * sc}" y1="{Z(pz)}" y2="{Z(pz)}" stroke="{lip}" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>')
            g.append(f'<text x="{oh + bh * sc - 3}" y="{Z(MEMBRANE_HALF / 2) + 3}" font-size="9" text-anchor="end" fill="#2f4a08">upper</text>')
            g.append(f'<text x="{oh + bh * sc - 3}" y="{Z(-MEMBRANE_HALF / 2) + 3}" font-size="9" text-anchor="end" fill="#2f4a08">lower</text>')
        else:
            g.append(f'<rect x="{oh}" y="{ov}" width="{bh * sc}" height="{bv * sc}" fill="{lip}" fill-opacity=".18"/>')
            g.append(f'<text x="{oh + 4}" y="{ov + 12}" font-size="10" fill="#5d6b77">membrane (z = 0, whole plane)</text>')
    for p in proteins:
        dashed = ' stroke-dasharray="3 2"' if p.get("dashed") else ""
        for i, c in enumerate(p["copies"]):
            hull = _hull2d(c[:, [ha, va]])
            pts = " ".join(f"{X(h):.1f},{Z(v):.1f}" for h, v in hull)
            g.append(f'<polygon points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-opacity=".9"/>')
            g.append(f'<polygon points="{pts}" fill="#b5541a" fill-opacity="{".4" if dashed else ".6"}" stroke="#7a3410" stroke-width="1.5"{dashed}/>')
            if i == 0:
                n = len(p["copies"])
                g.append(f'<text x="{X(hull[:, 0].max()) + 3}" y="{Z(c[:, va].mean()) + 4}" font-size="10" fill="#b5541a">'
                         f'{p["name"]}{" ×" + str(n) if n > 1 else ""}</text>')
    g.append(f'<text x="{oh + bh * sc - 4}" y="{ov + bv * sc - 4}" font-size="10" text-anchor="end" fill="#5d6b77">{bh:g} × {bv:g} nm ({view})</text>')
    return (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" width="100%" '
            f'style="background:#f5f7f9;border:1px solid #d3d9df;border-radius:4px;max-width:720px">' + "".join(g) + "</svg>")

docs.text:
Building the systems: from the settings to system.gro, system.pdb and topol.top.

MembraneRunner.run does the work, in the GUI as well as with omb cli:

  1. It creates the output folder (systems/, toppar/, user_inputs/) and copies the force field, the simulation settings (mdp/) and the run scripts into it.
  2. It copies the protein topologies to toppar/<name>.itp and names the molecule inside each one after the protein ([ moleculetype ] → <name> 1).
  3. For every composition (one, or one per template block) and every system (R0001, R0002, …) it works out where each protein goes, then lets COBY build the system.
  4. It tidies the topology: correct include paths, a descriptive title, one include and one summed line per protein that occurs in several copies.
  5. It packs everything into downloads/<output folder>.zip.

TopologyEditor holds the topology clean-ups; run_coby_simulation is the single place where COBY is called.

def run(self, config) -> list[str]:
    """Build every system of the configuration.

    Membrane-only systems and systems with proteins are handled alike; with proteins,
    their positions and rotations are worked out per system first (fixed, random, on a
    grid, independent copies, or two proteins at a given gap) and recorded in
    `config.protein_params`, so the build can be reproduced.

    Args:
        config: The membrane settings (`openmembranebuilder.builders.membrane.config.Config`).

    Returns:
        `(output_pdbs, zip_path)`: `(label, pdb path)` for every built system, and the
        path of the zip archive.
    """
    with_protein = bool(config.protein_files)

    base_folder    = config.base_folder or config.output_name
    systems_folder = os.path.join(base_folder, "systems")
    toppar_folder  = os.path.join(base_folder, self.global_info.toppar_folder)
    user_inputs_dir  = os.path.join(base_folder, "user_inputs")
    os.makedirs(base_folder,    exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(systems_folder, exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(toppar_folder,  exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(user_inputs_dir,   exist_ok=True)

    # Step 1 — copy shared files
    mdp_target = "protein" if with_protein else "membrane"
    self.file_manager.copy_ff_folder(config.selected_ff, toppar_folder)
    self.file_manager.copy_mdp_files(config.selected_ff, base_folder, mdp_target)
    self.file_manager.copy_scripts(base_folder)

    molecule_imports = self._build_molecule_imports(config)
    itp_input_ff     = f"include:{self.global_info.toppar_folder_path}/{config.selected_ff}.top"

    if with_protein:
        for pdb_name, paths in config.protein_files.items():
            original_itp = paths["itp_path"]
            stem = os.path.splitext(pdb_name)[0]
            itp_dest = os.path.join(toppar_folder, f"{stem}.itp")
            if os.path.abspath(original_itp) != os.path.abspath(itp_dest):
                shutil.copy2(original_itp, itp_dest)
            moleculetype_name = stem  # the protein's name, e.g. 1UBQ (itp, [ molecules ], COBY)
            self.topology_editor.overwrite_moleculetype_line(itp_dest, moleculetype_name=moleculetype_name)
            paths["itp_path"] = itp_dest
            self.file_manager.copy_userinput(original_itp, user_inputs_dir)
    if config.template_active and config.template_path and os.path.exists(config.template_path):              # ← new block
            config.template_path = self.file_manager.copy_userinput(config.template_path, user_inputs_dir)
    # Templates — entries is either a dict {name: entries} or a flat list
    templates = config.entries if isinstance(config.entries, dict) else {
        self.global_info.default_template_name: config.entries
    }
    if with_protein:
        for pdb_name, paths in config.protein_files.items():
            src = paths["pdb_path"]
            if os.path.exists(src):
                new_path = os.path.join(user_inputs_dir, pdb_name)
                if os.path.abspath(src) != os.path.abspath(new_path):
                    paths["pdb_path"] = self.file_manager.copy_userinput(src, user_inputs_dir)

    all_systems = []

    for template_name, entries in templates.items():

        config.entries_current = entries                                          
        config.membrane_string = self.membrane_parser.create_membrane_str(config) if entries else ""
        selected_molecule_builders = self._collect_selected_molecule_builders(config)
        suffix = f"{template_name}_" if template_name != self.global_info.default_template_name else ""

        params = {
            "boxx":               float(config.box_x),
            "boxy":               float(config.box_y),
            "boxz":               float(config.box_z),
            "box_type":           config.box_type,
            "moleculeimport":     molecule_imports,
            "molecule_builder":   selected_molecule_builders,
            "membrane":           config.membrane_string,
            "solvation":          config.solvation,
            "selectedforcefield": config.selected_ff,
        }

        # Step 2 — per-system pipeline
        for i in range(config.n_systems):
            folder_name = f"{suffix}R{i + 1:04d}"
            folder      = os.path.join(systems_folder, folder_name)
            os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)

            if with_protein:
                itp_includes = [f"include:{paths['itp_path']}" for paths in config.protein_files.values()]

                if config.more_copies and config.copy_number > 1:
                    params["itp_input"] = [itp_input_ff] + itp_includes * config.copy_number
                    # _insert_multiple_proteins still works on a single protein — see note below
                    first_pdb_name = next(iter(config.protein_files))
                    first_pdb_dest = os.path.join(folder, first_pdb_name)
                    shutil.copy2(config.protein_files[first_pdb_name]["pdb_path"], first_pdb_dest)
                    protein_line = self._insert_multiple_proteins(
                        first_pdb_dest, folder, config, molecule_imports, system_index=i
                    )
                else:
                    params["itp_input"] = [itp_input_ff] + itp_includes
                    protein_line = self._insert_protein(
                        folder, config, molecule_imports, system_index=i
                    )
            else:
                protein_line        = []
                params["itp_input"] = [itp_input_ff]

            coby_output = run_coby_simulation(params, protein_line, folder)
            self.topology_editor.edit_topology(config.selected_ff, folder)
            self.topology_editor.replace_placeholder_title(os.path.join(folder, "topol.top"), config)

            if with_protein:
                itp_names = [
                    f"{os.path.splitext(pdb_name)[0]}.itp"
                    for pdb_name in config.protein_files
                ]
                self.topology_editor.fix_protein_includes_only(
                    os.path.join(coby_output, "topol.top"), itp_names
                )
                if config.more_copies and config.copy_number > 1:
                    self.topology_editor.fix_multiple_protein_topology(
                        os.path.join(coby_output, "topol.top")
                    )

            all_systems.append(folder)

    # Step 3 — collect PDBs for visualization
    output_pdbs = self._collect_output_pdbs(all_systems)

    zip_path = self.file_manager.create_zip_folder(base_folder)

    return output_pdbs, zip_path

def _collect_selected_molecule_builders(self, config) -> list[str]:
    """The custom-lipid recipes needed by the composition being built.

    Args:
        config: The membrane settings.

    Returns:
        The recipes of the custom lipids that occur in the composition.
    """
    index = getattr(config, "molecule_builder_index", {}) or {}
    entries = getattr(config, "entries_current", []) or []

    selected_lipids = set()
    for entry in entries:
        if entry and len(entry) > 0:
            selected_lipids.add(entry[0])

    return [index[name] for name in sorted(selected_lipids) if name in index]

def _rotate_protein(self, config, system_index: int) -> None:
    """Decide the orientation of every protein, for all systems at once.

    Fixed angles are copied to every system; a random orientation is drawn once for all
    systems, or anew for every system with "re-randomize for each system". Runs for the
    first system, and again for later systems only when orientations change per system.

    Args:
        config: The membrane settings; `protein_params` is filled in.
        system_index: Number of the system being built (0 for `R0001`).
    """
    if system_index != 0 and not config.randomize_rot_every:
        return

    for pdb_name in config.protein_files:
        source = config.protein_params.get("R0001", {}).get(pdb_name, {})

        if config.randomize_rot and not config.randomize_rot_every:
            rx, ry, rz = [random.uniform(-180.0, 180.0) for _ in range(3)]
        elif not config.randomize_rot:
            rx = source.get("rx", 0.0)
            ry = source.get("ry", 0.0)
            rz = source.get("rz", 0.0)

        for i in range(config.n_systems):
            key = f"R{i + 1:04d}"
            if config.randomize_rot and config.randomize_rot_every:
                rx, ry, rz = [random.uniform(-180.0, 180.0) for _ in range(3)]
            config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["rx"] = round(rx, 4)
            config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["ry"] = round(ry, 4)
            config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["rz"] = round(rz, 4)

def _position_protein(self, config, system_index: int) -> None:
    """Decide the x/y position of every protein, for all systems at once.

    Fixed positions are copied to every system. A random position keeps 2.5 nm away from
    the box edge, and is drawn once for all systems or anew for every system.

    Args:
        config: The membrane settings; `protein_params` is filled in.
        system_index: Number of the system being built (0 for `R0001`).
    """
    margin = 2.5
    if system_index != 0 and not config.randomize_pos_every:
        return

    for pdb_name in config.protein_files:
        source = config.protein_params.get("R0001", {}).get(pdb_name, {})

        if config.randomize_pos and not config.randomize_pos_every:
            cx = random.uniform(-(config.box_x / 2 - margin), config.box_x / 2 - margin)
            cy = random.uniform(-(config.box_y / 2 - margin), config.box_y / 2 - margin)
        elif not config.randomize_pos:
            cx = source.get("cx", 0.0)
            cy = source.get("cy", 0.0)

        for i in range(config.n_systems):
            key = f"R{i + 1:04d}"
            if config.randomize_pos and config.randomize_pos_every:
                cx = random.uniform(-(config.box_x / 2 - margin), config.box_x / 2 - margin)
                cy = random.uniform(-(config.box_y / 2 - margin), config.box_y / 2 - margin)
            config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["cx"] = round(cx, 4)
            config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["cy"] = round(cy, 4)

def _resolve_cz(self, pdb_path: str, system_path: str, config,
        molecule_imports: list, rx: float, ry: float, rz: float,
        pdb_name: str = None, upper_z_mem: float | None = None) -> float:
    """The z position (height) of a protein, in nm from the box centre.

    - "Absolute z position": the value entered.
    - "Height above Membrane": a membrane of the same composition is built once without
      the protein, its upper surface is measured (average height of the highest 10 % of
      lipid beads), and the protein is placed so that its lowest bead – after rotation –
      is `distance_to_mem` above that surface.

    Args:
        pdb_path: The protein structure.
        system_path: The system folder (used for the temporary membrane).
        config: The membrane settings.
        molecule_imports: Extra structures COBY needs (e.g. cholesterol for Martini 2).
        rx: Rotation about x, in degrees.
        ry: Rotation about y, in degrees.
        rz: Rotation about z, in degrees.
        pdb_name: The protein's file name (to find its entered z).
        upper_z_mem: Membrane surface already measured, in Å (skips building it again).

    Returns:
        The z position, in nm.
    """
    if config.z_method != "Height above Membrane":
        filename = pdb_name or os.path.basename(pdb_path)
        return config.protein_params.get("R0001", {}).get(filename, {}).get("cz", 0.0)

    # the membrane surface is measured once and can be passed in (independent copies)
    if upper_z_mem is None:
        upper_z_mem = self._create_pure_membrane_system(system_path, config, molecule_imports)
    # surface height (Å, from the box bottom) -> nm from the box centre, plus the gap
    cz = upper_z_mem / 10.0 + config.distance_to_mem - config.box_z / 2

    u   = mda.Universe(pdb_path)
    com = u.atoms.center_of_geometry()
    rot = R.from_euler("XYZ", [rx, ry, rz], degrees=True)  # COBY: Rx·Ry·Rz
    rotated = rot.apply(u.atoms.positions - com) + com
    # COBY places the protein by its centre: lift it by the distance from its centre
    # down to its lowest bead, so the lowest bead sits at the requested gap
    cz += (rotated[:, 2].mean() - rotated[:, 2].min()) / 10.0
    return round(cz, 4)

def _insert_multiple_proteins(self, pdb_path: str, system_path: str, config,
                           molecule_imports: list, system_index: int) -> list[str]:
    """Place several copies of one protein in a system.

    "Move together": the box is divided into a grid, the copies take randomly chosen
    cells and share the protein's orientation (or each get a random one with "Randomize
    the rotation for all copies"). "Move independently" is handed to
    `_insert_independent_copies`.

    Args:
        pdb_path: The protein structure, copied into the system folder.
        system_path: The system folder.
        config: The membrane settings.
        molecule_imports: Extra structures COBY needs.
        system_index: Number of the system being built (0 for `R0001`).

    Returns:
        One COBY protein text per copy.
    """
    self._ensure_protein_params(config)
    self._rotate_protein(config, system_index)

    pdb_name  = next(iter(config.protein_files))   # single protein for multi-copy
    key       = f"R{system_index + 1:04d}"
    system_rx = config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["rx"]
    system_ry = config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["ry"]
    system_rz = config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["rz"]

    if getattr(config, "copy_mode", "together") == "independent":
        return self._insert_independent_copies(pdb_path, pdb_name, system_path, config, molecule_imports, system_index)

    grid   = self._make_grid(config.box_x, config.box_y, config.copy_number)
    random.shuffle(grid)
    points = grid[:config.copy_number]

    cz = self._resolve_cz(pdb_path, system_path, config, molecule_imports,
                        system_rx, system_ry, system_rz)

    lines = []
    for cx, cy in points:
        if config.randomize_rot_all_copies:
            rx = round(random.uniform(-180.0, 180.0), 4)
            ry = round(random.uniform(-180.0, 180.0), 4)
            rz = round(random.uniform(-180.0, 180.0), 4)
        else:
            rx, ry, rz = system_rx, system_ry, system_rz

        lines.append(self._build_protein_line(pdb_path, cx, cy, cz, rx, ry, rz,
                                              moleculetype=os.path.splitext(pdb_name)[0]))

    return lines  # list of strings, one per copy

def _insert_independent_copies(self, pdb_path: str, pdb_name: str, system_path: str, config,
                               molecule_imports: list, system_index: int) -> list[str]:
    """Place copies one by one, each with its own position and orientation.

    The poses come from the protein insertion page (`config.copy_params`). With a random
    orientation, every copy gets its own; it is drawn once and reused for all systems, or
    drawn again for every system with "re-randomize for each system". The poses used are
    recorded in `config.protein_params[<system>][<protein>]["copies"]`.

    Args:
        pdb_path: The protein structure.
        pdb_name: The protein's file name.
        system_path: The system folder.
        config: The membrane settings.
        molecule_imports: Extra structures COBY needs.
        system_index: Number of the system being built (0 for `R0001`).

    Returns:
        One COBY protein text per copy.
    """
    key = f"R{system_index + 1:04d}"
    first = config.protein_params.get("R0001", {}).get(pdb_name, {}).get("copies") or []
    upper = None
    if config.z_method == "Height above Membrane":
        upper = self._create_pure_membrane_system(system_path, config, molecule_imports)
    poses, lines = [], []
    for k in range(config.copy_number):
        cp = dict(config.copy_params[k]) if k < len(config.copy_params) else {"cx": 0.0, "cy": 0.0, "cz": 0.0}
        if config.randomize_rot:
            if system_index > 0 and not config.randomize_rot_every and k < len(first):
                cp.update({ax: first[k][ax] for ax in ("rx", "ry", "rz")})
            else:
                cp.update({ax: round(random.uniform(-180.0, 180.0), 4) for ax in ("rx", "ry", "rz")})
        rx, ry, rz = (cp.get(ax, 0.0) for ax in ("rx", "ry", "rz"))
        if config.z_method == "Height above Membrane":
            cz = self._resolve_cz(pdb_path, system_path, config, molecule_imports, rx, ry, rz, upper_z_mem=upper)
        else:
            cz = cp.get("cz", 0.0)
        poses.append({"cx": cp.get("cx", 0.0), "cy": cp.get("cy", 0.0), "cz": cz, "rx": rx, "ry": ry, "rz": rz})
        lines.append(self._build_protein_line(pdb_path, poses[-1]["cx"], poses[-1]["cy"], cz, rx, ry, rz,
                                              moleculetype=os.path.splitext(pdb_name)[0]))
    config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]["copies"] = poses
    return lines

def _insert_protein(self, system_path: str, config,
                molecule_imports: list, system_index: int = 0) -> list[str]:
    """Place each protein once in a system (no copies).

    Orientation, x/y position (or the two-protein gap) and height are decided, the
    structure is copied into the system folder and the COBY texts are made.

    Args:
        system_path: The system folder.
        config: The membrane settings.
        molecule_imports: Extra structures COBY needs.
        system_index: Number of the system being built (0 for `R0001`).

    Returns:
        One COBY protein text per protein.
    """
    self._ensure_protein_params(config)
    self._rotate_protein(config, system_index)

    # Distance mode overrides cx/cy
    if getattr(config, "use_protein_distance", False) and len(config.protein_files) == 2:
        self._position_two_proteins_by_distance(config, system_index)
    else:
        self._position_protein(config, system_index)

    key   = f"R{system_index + 1:04d}"
    lines = []

    for pdb_name, paths in config.protein_files.items():
        pdb_path = os.path.join(system_path, pdb_name)
        if not os.path.exists(pdb_path):
            shutil.copy2(paths["pdb_path"], pdb_path)

        params = config.protein_params[key][pdb_name]
        cz = self._resolve_cz(
            pdb_path, system_path, config, molecule_imports,
            params["rx"], params["ry"], params["rz"],
            pdb_name=pdb_name
        )
        params["cz"] = cz
        moleculetype = os.path.splitext(pdb_name)[0]
        lines.append(self._build_protein_line(
            pdb_path, params["cx"], params["cy"], cz,
            params["rx"], params["ry"], params["rz"],
            moleculetype=moleculetype,
        ))

    return lines

def _get_protein_extent_on_x(self, pdb_path: str, rx: float, ry: float, rz: float) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Half of the width of the rotated protein along x, in nm.

    Args:
        pdb_path: The protein structure.
        rx: Rotation about x, in degrees.
        ry: Rotation about y, in degrees.
        rz: Rotation about z, in degrees.

    Returns:
        Half the x width, in nm.
    """
    u   = mda.Universe(pdb_path)
    pos = u.atoms.positions  
    com = pos.mean(axis=0)
    rot = R.from_euler("XYZ", [rx, ry, rz], degrees=True)  # COBY: Rx·Ry·Rz
    rotated = rot.apply(pos - com)  # centered at origin

    x_min = rotated[:, 0].min() / 10.0  
    x_max = rotated[:, 0].max() / 10.0
    half_extent = (x_max - x_min) / 2.0
    return half_extent

def _position_two_proteins_by_distance(self, config, system_index: int) -> None:
    """Place two proteins side by side along x with a given gap between them.

    The first protein goes to +x, the second to −x, both at y = 0, so that the gap
    between their facing edges equals `config.protein_distance`.

    Args:
        config: The membrane settings; `protein_params` is filled in.
        system_index: Number of the system being built.
    """
    pdb_names = list(config.protein_files.keys())
    assert len(pdb_names) == 2, "Distance mode requires exactly 2 proteins"

    name_a, name_b = pdb_names

    for i in range(config.n_systems):
        key = f"R{i + 1:04d}"

        params_a = config.protein_params[key][name_a]
        params_b = config.protein_params[key][name_b]

        ext_a = self._get_protein_extent_on_x(
            config.protein_files[name_a]["pdb_path"],
            params_a["rx"], params_a["ry"], params_a["rz"],
        )
        ext_b = self._get_protein_extent_on_x(
            config.protein_files[name_b]["pdb_path"],
            params_b["rx"], params_b["ry"], params_b["rz"],
        )

        half_gap = config.protein_distance / 2.0

        x_a = +(ext_a + half_gap)
        x_b = -(ext_b + half_gap)

        config.protein_params[key][name_a]["cx"] = round(x_a, 4)
        config.protein_params[key][name_a]["cy"] = 0.0
        config.protein_params[key][name_b]["cx"] = round(x_b, 4)
        config.protein_params[key][name_b]["cy"] = 0.0

def _create_pure_membrane_system(self, system_path: str, config,
                                 molecule_imports: list) -> float:
    """Build the membrane once without proteins and measure its upper surface.

    The trial membrane is built in a temporary folder that is removed afterwards.

    Args:
        system_path: The system folder.
        config: The membrane settings.
        molecule_imports: Extra structures COBY needs.

    Returns:
        Height of the upper membrane surface, in Å from the bottom of the box
        (0.0 when the measurement failed).
    """
    now          = datetime.now()
    random_int   = random.randint(100000, 999999)
    temp_dir     = os.path.join(system_path,
                                f"temp_membrane_z-{now.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}-{random_int}")
    os.makedirs(temp_dir, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        membrane_params = {
            "boxx":               config.box_x,
            "boxy":               config.box_y,
            "boxz":               config.box_z,
            "box_type":           config.box_type,
            "membrane":           config.membrane_string,
            "moleculeimport":     molecule_imports,
            "solvation":          config.solvation,
            "selectedforcefield": config.selected_ff,
            "itp_input":          f"include:{self.global_info.toppar_folder_path}/{config.selected_ff}.top",
        }
        selected_molecule_builders = self._collect_selected_molecule_builders(config)
        if selected_molecule_builders:
            membrane_params["molecule_builder"] = selected_molecule_builders
        run_coby_simulation(membrane_params, "", temp_dir)
        return self._measure_membrane_z(os.path.join(temp_dir, "system.gro"), config)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Membrane Z measurement failed: {e}")
        return 0.0
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temp_dir):
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)

def _measure_membrane_z(self, gro_path: str, config) -> float:
    """The height of the upper membrane surface in a built system.

    Taken as the average height of the highest 10 % of the lipid beads.

    Args:
        gro_path: The built trial membrane (`system.gro`).
        config: The membrane settings (to know the lipid names).

    Returns:
        The height in Å, or 0.0 when it cannot be measured.
    """
    try:
        u           = mda.Universe(gro_path)
        lipid_names = [entry[0] for entry in config.entries_current]
        if not lipid_names:
            return 0.0
        lipid_atoms = u.select_atoms("resname " + " ".join(lipid_names))
        if len(lipid_atoms) == 0:
            return 0.0
        z       = lipid_atoms.positions[:, 2]
        n       = max(1, int(0.1 * len(z)))
        upper_z = float(np.mean(np.sort(z)[-n:]))
        return upper_z
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Membrane Z measurement failed: {e}")
        return 0.0

def _build_molecule_imports(self, config) -> list:
    """Extra structures COBY needs that are not part of its own library.

    With Martini 2.2: the cholesterol model chosen (`CHOL` or `CHOL2`) and antifreeze
    water (`WF`) when used.

    Args:
        config: The membrane settings.

    Returns:
        COBY import texts.
    """
    imports = []
    chol = self.membrane_parser.check_chol_import(config)
    if chol == "CHOL":
        imports.append(f"file:{self.global_info.chol_file} moleculetype:{chol} params:IMPORTED")
    elif chol == "CHOL2":
        imports.append(f"file:{self.global_info.chol2_file} moleculetype:{chol} params:IMPORTED")
    if config.selected_ff == "martini_v2.2" and "WF" in config.solvation:
        imports.append(f"file:{self.global_info.wf_file} moleculetype:WF params:IMPORTED")
    return imports

def _collect_output_pdbs(self, system_folders: list[str]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Write `system.pdb` next to every `system.gro` for the 3D view.

    Args:
        system_folders: The system folders that were built.

    Returns:
        `(folder name, pdb path)` for every system.
    """
    results = []
    for system_path in system_folders:
        gro_candidate = os.path.join(system_path, "eq3.gro")
        gro_path      = gro_candidate if os.path.exists(gro_candidate) \
                        else os.path.join(system_path, "system.gro")
        if not os.path.exists(gro_path):
            continue
        pdb_path = convert_gro_to_pdb(gro_path, gro_path.replace(".gro", ".pdb"))
        label    = os.path.basename(system_path)
        if pdb_path and os.path.exists(pdb_path):
            results.append((label, pdb_path))
    return results

def _make_grid(self, boxx: float, boxy: float, n_copies: int) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
    """The grid on which copies "moving together" are placed.

    Args:
        boxx: Box length x, in nm.
        boxy: Box length y, in nm.
        n_copies: Number of copies.

    Returns:
        Cell centres `(x, y)` in nm from the box centre (n × n cells, n² ≥ copies).
    """
    n  = math.ceil(math.sqrt(n_copies))
    dx = boxx / n
    dy = boxy / n
    return [
        (round((i + 0.5) * dx - boxx / 2, 4),
        round((j + 0.5) * dy - boxy / 2, 4))
        for i in range(n)
        for j in range(n)
    ]

The include lines of the force field are added in front of COBY's topology, and every include is made to point to ../../toppar/…, where the files are in the output.

def edit_topology(self, ff_name: str, destination: str):
    """Put the force-field includes at the top of `topol.top`, with correct paths.

    The include lines of the force field are added in front of COBY's topology, and every
    include is made to point to `../../toppar/…`, where the files are in the output.

    Args:
        ff_name: The force field, e.g. `"martini_v3"`.
        destination: The system folder with `topol.top`.
    """
    topol_file = os.path.join(destination, "topol.top")
    ff_itp = os.path.join(self.global_info.toppar_folder_path, f"{ff_name}.top")

    if not os.path.exists(ff_itp):
        print(f"{ff_itp} not found")
        return

    with open(ff_itp, 'r') as f:
        itp_lines = f.readlines()
    with open(topol_file, 'r') as f:
        topol_lines = f.readlines()[1:]

    def fix_include_path(line):
        """Make an `#include "…"` line point into `../../toppar/`."""
        return re.sub(
            r'(#include\s+")(.*?)(")',
            lambda m: m.group(1) + "../../toppar/" + m.group(2) + m.group(3),
            line
        )

    def collapse_blank_lines(text: str) -> str:
        """Replace runs of blank lines by a single blank line."""
        return re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', text)

    fixed_itp_lines   = [fix_include_path(line) for line in itp_lines]
    fixed_topol_lines = [fix_include_path(line) for line in topol_lines]

    merged = "".join(fixed_itp_lines) + "\n" + "".join(fixed_topol_lines)
    merged = collapse_blank_lines(merged)

    with open(topol_file, 'w') as f:
        f.write(merged)

def replace_placeholder_title(self, topol_path: str, config) -> None:
    """Give the system a descriptive title in `topol.top`.

    The title lists the protein names and the composition, e.g.
    `1UBQ_POPC_0.7_0.3_CHOL_0.3_0.7` (lipid, upper, lower for every lipid).

    Args:
        topol_path: The `topol.top` file.
        config: The membrane settings.
    """
    # Build membrane composition string
    entries = config.entries_current if hasattr(config, "entries_current") and config.entries_current \
            else (next(iter(config.entries.values())) if isinstance(config.entries, dict)
                    else config.entries)

    composition_parts = []
    for entry in entries:
        lipid, upper, lower = entry[0], entry[1], entry[2]
        # Format ratios: drop trailing zeros for cleanliness (1.0 → 1, 0.33 → 0.33)
        upper_str = str(int(upper)) if float(upper) == int(upper) else str(upper)
        lower_str = str(int(lower)) if float(lower) == int(lower) else str(lower)
        composition_parts.append(f"{lipid}_{upper_str}_{lower_str}")

    membrane_composition = "_".join(composition_parts)

    # Build full title
    if config.protein_files:
        protein_names = "_".join(
            os.path.splitext(n)[0] for n in config.protein_files
        )
        title = f"{protein_names}_{membrane_composition}"
    else:
        title = membrane_composition

    # Replace in file
    with open(topol_path, "r") as f:
        content = f.read()

    content = content.replace("PLACEHOLDER_TITLE", title)

    with open(topol_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(content)

    """Rename the molecule in an `.itp` file.

    The first line after `[ moleculetype ]` becomes `<name> 1`, so the topology lists the
    protein under its own name (for example `1UBQ`).

    Args:
        itp_file: The `.itp` file, changed in place.
        moleculetype_name: The new name.
    """
    with open(itp_file, 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    updated_lines = []
    inside_moleculetype = False

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if re.match(r'^\s*\[\s*moleculetype\s*\]', line, re.IGNORECASE):  
            inside_moleculetype = True
            updated_lines.append(line) 
            continue

        if inside_moleculetype and line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith(";"):

            updated_lines.append(f"{moleculetype_name} 1\n")
            updated_lines.extend(lines[i + 1:])  
            break

        updated_lines.append(line)  

    with open(itp_file, 'w') as f:
        f.writelines(updated_lines)

def fix_protein_includes_only(self, topol_path: str, protein_itp_names: list[str]):
    """Point the include lines of the protein topologies to `../../toppar/<name>.itp`.

    Args:
        topol_path: The `topol.top` file.
        protein_itp_names: The protein `.itp` file names, e.g. `["1UBQ.itp"]`.
    """
    with open(topol_path, 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    updated_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        matched = False
        for itp_name in protein_itp_names:
            pattern = rf'^\s*#include\s+"[^"]*{re.escape(itp_name)}"\s*$'
            if re.match(pattern, line):
                updated_lines.append(f'#include "../../toppar/{itp_name}"\n')
                matched = True
                break
        if not matched:
            updated_lines.append(line)

    with open(topol_path, 'w') as f:
        f.writelines(updated_lines)

COBY writes one #include and one <name> 1 line for every copy. Identical include lines are kept once, and consecutive lines of the same molecule in [ molecules ] are added up, e.g. three copies of 1UBQ become 1UBQ 3.

def fix_multiple_protein_topology(self, topol_path: str) -> None:
    """One include and one line per protein, however many copies there are.

    COBY writes one `#include` and one `<name> 1` line for every copy. Identical include
    lines are kept once, and consecutive lines of the same molecule in `[ molecules ]`
    are added up, e.g. three copies of 1UBQ become `1UBQ        3`.

    Args:
        topol_path: The `topol.top` file, changed in place.
    """
    with open(topol_path, "r") as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    # ── 1. Each #include only once ────────────────────────────────
    seen_includes = set()
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        if re.match(r'^\s*#include\s+"', line):
            key = line.strip()
            if key in seen_includes:
                continue
            seen_includes.add(key)
        cleaned.append(line)

    # ── 2. Sum consecutive lines of the same molecule in [ molecules ] ──
    result = []
    in_molecules = False
    pending_name, pending_count = None, 0

    def flush():
        """Write the molecule line collected so far."""
        nonlocal pending_name, pending_count
        if pending_name is not None:
            result.append(f"{pending_name:<12s}{pending_count}\n")
        pending_name, pending_count = None, 0

    for line in cleaned:
        if re.match(r'^\s*\[\s*molecules\s*\]', line):
            in_molecules = True
            result.append(line)
            continue
        if in_molecules:
            if re.match(r'^\s*\[', line):
                flush()
                in_molecules = False
            else:
                m = re.match(r'^\s*(\S+)\s+(\d+)\s*$', line)
                if m and not line.lstrip().startswith(";"):
                    name, count = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
                    if name == pending_name:
                        pending_count += count
                    else:
                        flush()
                        pending_name, pending_count = name, count
                    continue
                flush()
        result.append(line)
    flush()

    with open(topol_path, "w") as f:
        f.writelines(result)

def run_coby_simulation(params: dict, protein_lines: Optional[str], system_path: str) -> str:
    """Build one system with COBY.

    Translates the settings into COBY's arguments – box (by box type), membrane,
    solvation, topology includes, extra structures, custom lipids and proteins – and
    writes `system.gro` and `topol.top` into the system folder.

    Args:
        params: Box, membrane, solvation and topology settings.
        protein_lines: COBY protein texts (one per protein or copy), or empty.
        system_path: The system folder.

    Returns:
        The system folder.

    Raises:
        ValueError: The box type is not known.
    """

    box_type = params.get("box_type", params.get("boxtype", "rectangular"))

    # COBY wants only the lengths each box type needs: x, y, z (rectangular),
    # x and z (hexagonal) or x alone (skewed hexagonal)
    if box_type == "rectangular":
        box = [
            float(params["boxx"]),
            float(params["boxy"]),
            float(params["boxz"]),
        ]

    elif box_type == "hexagonal":
        box = [
            float(params["boxx"]),
            float(params["boxz"]),
        ]

    elif box_type == "skewed_hexagonal":
        box = [
            float(params["boxx"]),
        ]


    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported box_type: {box_type}")


    coby_args = {
        "box_type": box_type,
        "box": box,
        "solvation": params["solvation"],
        "itp_input": params.get("itp_input"),
        "out_sys": os.path.join(system_path, "system.gro"),
        "out_top": os.path.join(system_path, "topol.top"),
    }

    if params.get("membrane"):
        coby_args["membrane"] = params["membrane"]

    if params.get("moleculeimport"):
        coby_args["molecule_import"] = params["moleculeimport"]
    if params.get("molecule_builder"):
        coby_args["molecule_builder"] = params["molecule_builder"]


    if protein_lines:
        coby_args["protein"] = protein_lines

    print(coby_args)
    COBY.COBY(**coby_args)

    return system_path

def _merge_external_available_lipids(
    self,
    available_lipids: list[str],
    selected_ff: str,
    extern_config: dict | None = None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Add lipids supplied from outside (custom lipids) to the list of a force field.

    Args:
        available_lipids: Lipids found in the force field.
        selected_ff: The force field.
        extern_config: Extra lipid definitions, each with its force field.

    Returns:
        All lipid names, sorted.
    """
    extern_config = extern_config or {}
    lipid_definitions = extern_config.get("lipid_definitions", {})

    merged = set(available_lipids)

    for lipid_name, lipid_info in lipid_definitions.items():
        lipid_ff = lipid_info.get("force_field") or lipid_info.get("selected_ff")
        if lipid_ff == selected_ff:
            merged.add(lipid_name)

    return sorted(merged)

def _merge_external_lipid_map(
    self,
    lipid_map: dict,
    selected_ff: str,
    extern_config: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """Add descriptions of lipids supplied from outside to the lipid table.

    Args:
        lipid_map: Descriptions found in the force field.
        selected_ff: The force field.
        extern_config: Extra lipid definitions.

    Returns:
        All descriptions, by lipid name.
    """
    extern_config = extern_config or {}
    lipid_definitions = extern_config.get("lipid_definitions", {})

    merged = dict(lipid_map)

    for lipid_name, lipid_info in lipid_definitions.items():
        lipid_ff = lipid_info.get("force_field") or lipid_info.get("selected_ff")
        if lipid_ff != selected_ff:
            continue

        merged[lipid_name] = {
            "resname": lipid_name,
            "moltype": lipid_info.get("moltype", ""),
            "head": lipid_info.get("head", ""),
            "linker": lipid_info.get("linker", ""),
            "tail1": lipid_info.get("tail1", ""),
            "tail2": lipid_info.get("tail2", ""),
            "tail1_beads": lipid_info.get("tail1_beads", ""),
            "tail2_beads": lipid_info.get("tail2_beads", ""),
            "is_custom": lipid_info.get("is_custom", True),
            "source": lipid_info.get("source", "external"),
            "force_field": lipid_ff,
        }

    return merged

def discover_membrane_templates(
    self,
    resources_dir: str | os.PathLike[str] | None = None,
) -> list[Path]:
    """The predefined membrane templates (`.csv` / `.ob`) in the resources folder.

    Args:
        resources_dir: Another resources folder to look in.

    Returns:
        The template files, sorted by name.
    """
    base_dir = Path(resources_dir) if resources_dir is not None else Path(self.global_info.resources_path)
    templates_dir = base_dir / "membrane_templates"
    if not templates_dir.exists():
        return []

    return sorted(
        [
            p for p in templates_dir.iterdir()
            if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in {".csv", ".ob"}
        ],
        key=lambda p: p.name.lower(),
    )

    """
    ffpath = self.toppardir / fffile
    if not ffpath.is_file():
        return []

    includes = []
    try:
        with open(ffpath, 'r') as f:
            content = f.read()
        includepattern = r'#include\s+"([^"]+\.itp)"'
        matches = re.findall(includepattern, content, re.IGNORECASE)
        for match in matches:
            includepath = self.toppardir / match
            if includepath.exists():
                includes.append(includepath)
    except Exception:
        return []
    return includes

def extractmoleculetypessinglefile(self, filepath: str) -> List[str]:
    """The molecule names defined in one lipid `.itp` file.

    Only files whose name points to lipids (phospholipids, sterols, ceramides, …) are
    read; other files return nothing.

    Args:
        filepath: The `.itp` file.

    Returns:
        Molecule names, sorted.
    """
    keywords = ['lipids', 'sterols', 'ceramides', 'plasmalogens', 'DOTAP', 
               'diglycerides', 'triglycerides', 'monoglycerides', 'CHOL']
    filename = os.path.basename(filepath).lower()
    if not any(k.lower() in filename for k in keywords) or not filepath.endswith('.itp'):
        return []

    moleculetypes = set()
    moleculetypepattern = re.compile(r'\[[\s]*moleculetype[\s]*\]', re.IGNORECASE)
    try:
        with open(filepath, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
        found = False
        for line in lines:
            line = line.strip()
            if line.startswith(';') or not line:
                continue
            if found:
                moleculetypes.add(line.split()[0])
                found = False
            if moleculetypepattern.match(line):
                found = True
    except:
        pass
    return sorted(list(moleculetypes))

def scanfflipids(self, fffile: str) -> List[str]:
    """All lipids of a force field.

    Args:
        fffile: The force field, e.g. `"martini_v3"`.

    Returns:
        Lipid names, sorted (also remembered in `lipidmap`).

    ff_file = fffile + ".top"

def buildlipidmap(self, fffile: str) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    """A description of every lipid of a force field, for the lipid table.

    The description is read from the comments in the force-field files: the title line
    (`Martini lipid topology for …`) gives the tails, the description gives the head group
    and the `@COBY` line gives the lipid type and bead names. Sterols without such lines
    are recognised by name. Some force-field specific labels (e.g. the two cholesterol
    models of Martini 2.2) are set explicitly.

    Args:
        fffile: The force field, e.g. `"martini_v3"`.

    Returns:
        `{lipid: {resname, moltype, head, linker, tail1, tail2, tail1_beads, tail2_beads}}`.
    """

    # ── Lookup tables ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    HEADGROUP_MAP = {
        "PC":   "Phosphatidylcholine (PC)",
        "PE":   "Phosphatidylethanolamine (PE)",
        "PG":   "Phosphatidylglycerol (PG)",
        "PS":   "Phosphatidylserine (PS)",
        "PA":   "Phosphatidic acid (PA)",
        "PI":   "Phosphatidylinositol (PI)",
        "PIP":  "Phosphatidylinositol phosphate (PIP)",
        "PIP2": "Phosphatidylinositol bisphosphate (PIP2)",
        "PIP3": "Phosphatidylinositol trisphosphate (PIP3)",
        "SM":   "Sphingomyelin (SM)",
        "CER":  "Ceramide",
        "GLUC": "Glucosylceramide",
        "GALA": "Galactosylceramide",
        "LPC":  "Lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC)",
        "LPE":  "Lysophosphatidylethanolamine (LPE)",
        "DAG":  "Diacylglycerol (DAG)",
        "TAG":  "Triacylglycerol (TAG)",
        "MAG":  "Monoacylglycerol (MAG)",
        "CHOL": "Cholesterol",
        "CL":  "Cardiolipin (CL)",
    }

    # Forcefield-specific sterol label overrides.
    # Key: fffile name (or normalized prefix). Value: {resname: (head_label, moltype_label)}.
    # martini3: no entry needed — HEADGROUP_MAP + sterol fallback block
    #           already produce the correct "Cholesterol" label and "Sterol" moltype.
    STEROL_OVERRIDES: Dict[str, Dict[str, tuple]] = {
        "martini_v2.2": {
            "CHOL":  ("Cholesterol (default)", "Sterol"),
            "CHOL2": ("Improved Cholesterol (https://doi.org/10.26434/chemrxiv-2022-t41rx)",  "Sterol"),
        },
        "martini_v3": {
            "CHOL": ("Cholesterol", "Sterol"),
        },
    }

    MOLTYPE_LINKER_MAP = {
        "phospholipid_ltf":     "Glycerol",
        "lysophospholipid_ltf": "Glycerol (lyso)",
        "sphingolipid_ltf":     "Sphingoid base (ceramide-type)",
        "ceramide_ltf":         "Sphingoid base (ceramide-type)",
        "glycolipid_ltf":       "Glycerol",
        "ether_ltf":            "Glycerol (ether-linked)",
        "plasmalogen_ltf":      "Glycerol (vinyl-ether)",
        "sterol_ltf":           "Sterol backbone",
        "diglyceride_ltf":      "Glycerol",
        "triglyceride_ltf":     "Glycerol",
        "monoglyceride_ltf":    "Glycerol",
        "cardiolipin_ltf":      "Glycerol (cardiolipin)",
    }

    MOLTYPE_LABEL_MAP = {
        "phospholipid_ltf":     "Phospholipid",
        "lysophospholipid_ltf": "Lysophospholipid",
        "sphingolipid_ltf":     "Sphingolipid",
        "ceramide_ltf":         "Ceramide",
        "glycolipid_ltf":       "Glycolipid",
        "ether_ltf":            "Ether lipid",
        "plasmalogen_ltf":      "Plasmalogen",
        "sterol_ltf":           "Sterol",
        "diglyceride_ltf":      "Diglyceride",
        "triglyceride_ltf":     "Triglyceride",
        "monoglyceride_ltf":    "Monoglyceride",
        "cardiolipin_ltf":      "Cardiolipin",
    }

    # Known sterol resnames to detect in files that lack @COBY annotations.
    KNOWN_STEROLS = {"CHOL", "CHOL2"}

    # ── Regex patterns ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    title_pat = re.compile(
        r';{2,}\s*Martini lipid topology for\s+(.+?)\s+\((\w+)\)',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    desc_pat = re.compile(
        r';\s*Description\s*:\s*\n((?:;[^\n]*\n)+)',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    coby_pat = re.compile(
        r'@COBY\s+'
        r'moltype:(?P<moltype>\S+)\s+'
        r'(?:core:(?P<core>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'(?:linker1:(?P<linker1>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'(?:tail11:(?P<tail11>\S+)\s+tail12:(?P<tail12>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'(?:linker2:(?P<linker2>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'(?:tail21:(?P<tail21>\S+)\s+tail22:(?P<tail22>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'(?:head:(?P<head>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'(?:tail1:(?P<tail1>\S+)\s+tail2:(?P<tail2>\S+)\s+)?'
        r'name:(?P<name>\S+)',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )
    # Detects [ moleculetype ] blocks whose name is a known sterol (no @COBY needed).
    sterol_moltype_pat = re.compile(
        r'\[\s*moleculetype\s*\]\s*\n\s*(\w+)',
        re.IGNORECASE
    )

    # ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def beads_to_acyl(bead_str: str) -> str:
        """A rough tail description from its bead letters (4 carbons per bead, D/T beads = double bonds).
        """
        if not bead_str:
            return "Unknown"
        carbons = len(bead_str) * 4
        double_bonds = sum(1 for b in bead_str if b in ('D', 'd', 'c', 't', 'T'))
        prefix = "d" if bead_str[0].lower() == 't' else "C"
        return f"{prefix}{carbons}:{double_bonds} (est.)"

    def parse_tails_from_title(fragment: str):
        """The two tails named in a title such as `C16:0/18:1`, `di-C18:1` or `C(d18:1/16:0)`.
        """
        fragment = fragment.strip()

        # di-CXX:Y → both tails identical
        di_match = re.match(
            r'di-[Cc](\d+:\d+(?:\([^)]*\))?)',
            fragment,
            re.IGNORECASE
        )
        if di_match:
            tail = "C" + di_match.group(1)
            return tail, tail

        # Sphingolipid: C(d18:1/12:0)
        sphingo = re.match(r'[Cc]\((.*?)\)', fragment)
        if sphingo:
            parts = [p.strip() for p in sphingo.group(1).split('/')]
            t1 = parts[0]
            t2 = ("C" + parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else None
            return t1, t2

        # Standard diacyl: C18:1/22:1 or C18:1(9c)/22:1(13c)
        standard = re.match(
            r'[Cc]?(\d+:\d+(?:\([^)]*\))?)\s*/\s*(\d+:\d+(?:\([^)]*\))?)',
            fragment
        )
        if standard:
            return "C" + standard.group(1), "C" + standard.group(2)

        # Single chain (lyso)
        single = re.match(r'[Cc](\d+:\d+(?:\([^)]*\))?)', fragment)
        if single:
            return "C" + single.group(1), None

        return fragment, None

    def headgroup_from_description(desc_text: str) -> str | None:
        """The head group named in a lipid's description, or `None`."""
        t = desc_text.lower()
        keywords = [
            ("phosphatidylinositol bisphosphate", "Phosphatidylinositol bisphosphate (PIP2)"),
            ("phosphatidylinositol phosphate",    "Phosphatidylinositol phosphate (PIP)"),
            ("phosphatidylinositol",              "Phosphatidylinositol (PI)"),
            ("phosphatidylcholine",               "Phosphatidylcholine (PC)"),
            ("phosphatidylethanolamine",          "Phosphatidylethanolamine (PE)"),
            ("phosphatidylglycerol",              "Phosphatidylglycerol (PG)"),
            ("phosphatidylserine",                "Phosphatidylserine (PS)"),
            ("phosphatidic acid",                 "Phosphatidic acid (PA)"),
            ("lysophosphatidylcholine",           "Lysophosphatidylcholine (LPC)"),
            ("lysophosphatidylethanolamine",      "Lysophosphatidylethanolamine (LPE)"),
            ("sphingomyelin",                     "Sphingomyelin (SM)"),
            ("glucosylceramide",                  "Glucosylceramide"),
            ("galactosylceramide",                "Galactosylceramide"),
            ("ceramide",                          "Ceramide"),
            ("ganglioside",                       "Ganglioside"),
            ("cholesterol",                       "Cholesterol"),
            ("ergosterol",                        "Ergosterol"),
            ("diacylglycerol",                    "Diacylglycerol (DAG)"),
            ("triacylglycerol",                   "Triacylglycerol (TAG)"),
            ("monoacylglycerol",                  "Monoacylglycerol (MAG)"),
            ("ether lipid",                       "Ether lipid"),
            ("plasmalogen",                       "Plasmalogen"),
            ("cardiolipin",                       "Cardiolipin (CL)"),
        ]
        for kw, label in keywords:
            if kw in t:
                return label
        return None

    def parse_itp_for_lipids(itppath: Path) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
        """Descriptions of all lipids in one `.itp` file."""
        results = {}
        try:
            with open(itppath, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
                content = f.read()
        except Exception:
            return results

        # ── @COBY-annotated lipids (phospholipids, sphingolipids, etc.) ──
        if "@COBY" in content:
            coby_matches = coby_pat.findall(content)

            blocks = re.split(r'(?=;{2,}\s*Martini lipid topology for\s)', content)
            block_by_name: Dict[str, str] = {}
            for block in blocks:
                m = title_pat.search(block)
                if m:
                    block_by_name[m.group(2)] = block

            for match in coby_pat.finditer(content):
                moltype_raw = match.group('moltype')
                head_raw = match.group('head') or match.group('core') or ''
                tail1_beads = match.group('tail11') or match.group('tail1')
                tail2_beads = match.group('tail21') or match.group('tail2')
                name = match.group('name')
                block = block_by_name.get(name, content)

                tail1_str = tail2_str = None
                title_m = title_pat.search(block)
                if title_m:
                    tail1_str, tail2_str = parse_tails_from_title(title_m.group(1))
                if not tail1_str:
                    tail1_str = beads_to_acyl(tail1_beads) if tail1_beads else "Unknown"
                if not tail2_str:
                    tail2_str = beads_to_acyl(tail2_beads) if tail2_beads else "None"

                head_label = None
                desc_m = desc_pat.search(block)
                if desc_m:
                    head_label = headgroup_from_description(desc_m.group(1))
                if not head_label:
                    if 'cardiolipin' in moltype_raw.lower():
                        head_label = HEADGROUP_MAP.get('CL', 'Cardiolipin (CL)')
                    else:
                        head_label = HEADGROUP_MAP.get(head_raw.upper(), f"Headgroup ({head_raw})")

                linker_label = MOLTYPE_LINKER_MAP.get(
                    moltype_raw.lower(), f"Unknown ({moltype_raw})"
                )
                moltype_label = MOLTYPE_LABEL_MAP.get(moltype_raw.lower(), moltype_raw)

                results[name] = {
                    "resname":     name,
                    "moltype":     moltype_label,
                    "head":        head_label,
                    "linker":      linker_label,
                    "tail1":       tail1_str,
                    "tail2":       tail2_str,
                    "tail1_beads": tail1_beads,
                    "tail2_beads": tail2_beads,
                }

        # ── Sterol fallback — catch sterols that carry no @COBY tag ──
        # Sterols in martini2, martini_v2.2, and martini3 often lack @COBY.
        # Detect them by moleculetype name and synthesize a proper Sterol entry.
        for match in sterol_moltype_pat.finditer(content):
            name = match.group(1).upper()
            if name not in KNOWN_STEROLS or name in results:
                continue  # skip non-sterols and already-parsed entries

            head_label = None
            desc_m = desc_pat.search(content)
            if desc_m:
                head_label = headgroup_from_description(desc_m.group(1))
            if not head_label:
                head_label = HEADGROUP_MAP.get(name, f"Sterol ({name})")

            results[name] = {
                "resname":     name,
                "moltype":     "Sterol",
                "head":        head_label,
                "linker":      "Sterol backbone",
                "tail1":       "None",
                "tail2":       "None",
                "tail1_beads": "",
                "tail2_beads": "",
            }

        return results

    # ── Main: follow the same include chain as scanfflipids() ─────────

    ff_file = fffile + ".top"
    includes = self.parseincludes(ff_file)

    lipid_detail_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}

    for incpath in includes:
        if self.extractmoleculetypes(incpath):
            lipid_detail_map.update(parse_itp_for_lipids(incpath))

    # ── Apply forcefield-specific sterol label overrides ──────────────
    # Normalize martini_v2.x variants to "martini2" so all v2 forcefields
    # share the same override block unless explicitly listed.
    _ff_key = fffile if fffile in STEROL_OVERRIDES else (
        "martini2" if fffile.startswith("martini_v2") else fffile
    )
    ff_overrides = STEROL_OVERRIDES.get(_ff_key, {})

    for resname, (head_label, moltype_label) in ff_overrides.items():
        if resname in lipid_detail_map:
            # Patch labels on an entry already found during parsing
            lipid_detail_map[resname]["head"]    = head_label
            lipid_detail_map[resname]["moltype"] = moltype_label
        else:
            # Synthesize a stub entry (e.g. CHOL2 absent from parsed files)
            lipid_detail_map[resname] = {
                "resname":     resname,
                "moltype":     moltype_label,
                "head":        head_label,
                "linker":      "Sterol backbone",
                "tail1":       "None",
                "tail2":       "None",
                "tail1_beads": "",
                "tail2_beads": "",
            }

    self.detailedlipidmap = lipid_detail_map
    return lipid_detail_map

def load_membrane_template_from_csv(self, uploaded_file, available_lipids: list, gui=True):
    """Read a membrane template (`.csv` or `.ob`).

    A template has one or more blocks; each starts with `# Name` and lists one lipid per
    line: `lipid, upper, lower[, area per lipid upper, area per lipid lower]`. Text after
    `;` is a comment. A file without `# Name` lines is one block called `single_setup`.

    Args:
        uploaded_file: The template file.
        available_lipids: The lipids of the force field (unknown lipids are an error).
        gui: Show errors on the page (`True`) or print them (`False`).

    Returns:
        `{block name: [[lipid, upper, lower, AU, AL], ...]}`, or `None` when the file
        cannot be used.
    """
    try:
        with open(uploaded_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        if gui:
            st.error(f"Could not read template file: {e}")
        else:
            print(f"Could not read template file: {e}")
        return

    # --- Split into named blocks by lines starting with '#' ---
    blocks = {}
    current_name = "__default__"
    current_lines = []

    for line in content.splitlines():
        if ";" in line:
            line = line[:line.index(";")]
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            # Save previous block if it has content
            if current_lines:
                blocks[current_name] = current_lines
            current_name = stripped.lstrip("#").strip().replace(" ", "_")
            current_lines = []
        elif stripped:  # skip blank lines
            current_lines.append(stripped)

    # Save the last block
    if current_lines:
        blocks[current_name] = current_lines

    if not blocks:
        st.error("CSV file appears to be empty.")
        return

    # --- Parse each block independently ---
    parsed_templates = {}

    for name, lines in blocks.items():
        try:
            df = self._parse_membrane_block(lines, available_lipids, block_name=name)
        except ValueError:
            return None  # error already shown via st.error inside the helper
        if df is None:
            return None
        parsed_templates[name] = df.to_dict(orient="records")

    # --- Store results ---
    # Rename internal sentinel to the public "default" key
    if "__default__" in parsed_templates:
        parsed_templates["single_setup"] = parsed_templates.pop("__default__")

    # Always store as dict {name: entries}
    entries_dict = {
        name: self._records_to_entries(records)
        for name, records in parsed_templates.items()
    }

    return entries_dict

def _parse_membrane_block(self, lines: list[str], available_lipids: list, block_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    """Read the lipid lines of one template block and check them.

    Missing areas per lipid become 0.6 nm², missing leaflet values 0.

    Args:
        lines: The lipid lines of the block.
        available_lipids: The lipids of the force field.
        block_name: Name of the block (for messages).

    Returns:
        A table with one row per lipid.

    Raises:
        ValueError: Wrong number of columns, or a lipid that does not exist.
    """
    from io import StringIO
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(StringIO("\n".join(lines)), header=None)
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"Could not parse block '{block_name}': {e}")
        raise ValueError (f"Could not parse block '{block_name}': {e}")


    n_cols = len(df.columns)

    if n_cols == 3:
        df.columns = ["resname", "upper leaflet ratio", "lower leaflet ratio"]
        df["upper leaflet apl"] = 0.6
        df["lower leaflet apl"] = 0.6

    elif n_cols == 5:
        df.columns = [
            "resname",
            "upper leaflet ratio",
            "lower leaflet ratio",
            "upper leaflet apl",
            "lower leaflet apl",
        ]
        df["upper leaflet ratio"] = df["upper leaflet ratio"].fillna(0)
        df["lower leaflet ratio"] = df["lower leaflet ratio"].fillna(0)
        df["upper leaflet apl"] = df["upper leaflet apl"].fillna(0.6)
        df["lower leaflet apl"] = df["lower leaflet apl"].fillna(0.6)

    else:
        st.error(
            f"Block '{block_name}': unexpected number of columns ({n_cols}). "
            f"CSV must have 3 columns (resname, upper ratio, lower ratio) "
            f"or 5 columns (+ upper APL, lower APL)."
        )
        raise ValueError (
            f"Block '{block_name}': unexpected number of columns ({n_cols}). "
            f"CSV must have 3 columns (resname, upper ratio, lower ratio) "
            f"or 5 columns (+ upper APL, lower APL)."
        )


    # --- Validate resnames ---
    for resname in df["resname"]:
        if resname not in available_lipids:
            st.error(
                f"Block '{block_name}': lipid '{resname}' is not available. "
                f"Please check your composition."
            )
            raise ValueError (
                f"Block '{block_name}': lipid '{resname}' is not available. "
                f"Please check your composition."
            )


    return df

def setup_lipids(self, forcefield: str, extern_config: dict | None = None):
    """The lipids of a force field and a starting composition.

    Args:
        forcefield: The force field.
        extern_config: Optional extra lipids.

    Returns:
        `available_lipids` and a starting row for fraction and number mode.
    """
    available_lipids = self.parser.scanfflipids(forcefield)

    extern_config = extern_config or {}
    lipid_definitions = extern_config.get("lipid_definitions", {})

    for lipid_name, lipid_info in lipid_definitions.items():
        lipid_ff = lipid_info.get("force_field") or lipid_info.get("selected_ff")
        if lipid_ff == forcefield and lipid_name not in available_lipids:
            available_lipids.append(lipid_name)

    available_lipids = sorted(available_lipids)
    if not available_lipids:
        available_lipids = ["POPC"]

    default_entry = [available_lipids[0], 1.0, 1.0, 0.6, 0.6]
    return {
        "available_lipids": available_lipids,
        "entries_rel": [default_entry],
        "entries_abs": [default_entry],
    }

def lipid_args(self, lip, ff) -> str:
    """COBY's options for one lipid: where its charge and parameters come from.

    Custom lipids use the molecule-builder parameters, Martini 2.2 lipids COBY's Martini 2
    library (cholesterol is imported from the shipped structure), and Martini 3 lipids one
    of COBY's built-in Martini 3 parameter sets.

    Args:
        lip: The lipid name.
        ff: The force field.

    Returns:
        An option text such as `"charge:top:params:TOP"`.
    """
    molecule_builder_index = getattr(self.config, "molecule_builder_index", {}) or {}

    if lip in molecule_builder_index:
        return "charge:lib:params:MFB"

    if self.config.selected_ff == "martini_v2.2":
        if lip == "CHOL" or lip == "CHOL2":
            self.config.chol_import_needed = "CHOL" if lip == "CHOL" else "CHOL2"
            return "charge:lib:params:IMPORTED"
        return "charge:top:params:M2"

    if len(lip) == 4 and lip[-2] == "P":
        return "charge:top:params:TOP"

    if len(lip) == 3 and lip[-2:] == "SM":
        return "charge:top:params:TOP"
    if len(lip) == 4 and lip[-2:] == "CL":
        return "charge:top:params:TOP"

    return "charge:top:params:default"
